measurements.definition: Same calibrated source, camera, disclosures, snap, review state and original 4000 x 3000 scene; same ordered final vertices and confirmed state. Both include a genuine dimension correction and every edge dimension entry. Candidate dimensions use the new per-edge input/change operation, while the identical retained manual route uses official edge inputs. Clicks, drags, select choices and text replacements each count one action (Tab belongs to that replacement); tool/tab/disclosure navigation included. Import/calibration, Save/New/Open and automatic locator scrolling excluded. This newly executed UI protocol is distinct from the retained legacy select/fill/Apply protocol; historical action counts remain attached to their original artifacts. Machine wall time includes automation settling, not human reading or operation time. Snap disabled for both routes before measurement.
